document.name: Morrowfin Relay SLA
document.text:
Morrowfin Relay Availability Terms 2026
Vendor: Morrowfin Relay.
Effective from 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
For Relay Queue on the Core plan, monthly availability is 100 multiplied by (1 minus eligible downtime minutes divided by all minutes in the UTC calendar month).
For Relay Queue on the Core plan, monthly availability below 99.9% earns a 10% service credit; monthly availability below 99.0% earns a 25% service credit. Only the highest applicable percentage applies.
Service credits are calculated from the affected monthly subscription fee, excluding tax, support and one-time charges, and apply to a future invoice.
Claims must be received within 20 calendar days after the end of the affected month.

pricing_evidence.text: For Relay Queue Core, the fixed monthly subscription price is USD 248.00 for one complete UTC calendar month. Billing occurs after the service month.
